title: MorphoID: frozen conditional identifiability audit code and derived data
description: Frozen H&E–Xenium pulmonary fibrosis pilot: donor-held-out model ladder, cross-fitted residual analysis, shortcut controls and finite-donor uncertainty. Includes original code, registered configurations, derived de-identified regional features and embeddings, full-precision result/source tables and vector figures. No upstream raw images or checkpoint weights are redistributed. Negative results and invalid inference entries are preserved; no external validation is claimed. Licensing is mixed: original code is MIT; Phikon-v2-derived embeddings and results are subject to the Owkin non-commercial research license and its share-alike terms, reproduced in licenses/OWKIN_PHIKON_V2_LICENSE.pdf. Public access does not authorize commercial use of these outputs.
